caseName: City Trust Co. v. Bankers Mortgage Loan Co.
caseNameFull: City Trust Company v. Bankers Mortgage Loan Company
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Nebraska.
attorneys: Mr. Sylvester R. Rush for plaintiff in error., Mr. Frank H. Gaines and Mr. C. J. Baird for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
